yango-client-id.title: Yango Client ID (clid)
yango-client-id.description: Requires a Yango partner agreement. Storing this does not yet enable a Yango provider — no adapter is implemented.

steps: Read the Yango partner-program documentation to confirm Yango operates in your service area.
Email Yango integration support to request partner access, describing your deployment and expected request volume.
Yango issues a client id (clid) and an API key once the partnership is agreed.
Paste the client id here and the key in the Yango API Key field.
x-openmapx-setup.cost: No public price schedule; set by the partner agreement.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Yango's fare and ETA endpoints require both the client id and the API key. The key is sent as a request header, never as a URL parameter.

yango-api-key.title: Yango API Key
yango-api-key.description: Requires a Yango partner agreement. Storing this does not yet enable a Yango provider — no adapter is implemented.

steps: Request partner access from Yango integration support.
Yango issues the API key alongside the client id.
x-openmapx-setup.cost: No public price schedule; set by the partner agreement.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Yango requires a cost disclaimer to be shown beside any fare estimate — fares vary with demand.

karhoo-client-id.title: Karhoo Client ID
karhoo-client-id.description: Requires a Karhoo demand-partner account. Storing this does not yet enable a Karhoo provider — no adapter is implemented.

steps: Contact Karhoo to open a demand-partner account — credentials are registered by a Karhoo representative, not self-service.
Karhoo provisions sandbox credentials first, then production ones once integration is reviewed.
Paste the client id here and the secret in the Karhoo Client Secret field.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Karhoo is a supply exchange rather than a single fleet, so one credential reaches many operators. Its API covers quotes, booking, tracking and cancellation, which is the full RideProvider surface.

karhoo-client-secret.title: Karhoo Client Secret
karhoo-client-secret.description: Requires a Karhoo demand-partner account. Storing this does not yet enable a Karhoo provider — no adapter is implemented.

steps: Open a Karhoo demand-partner account through a Karhoo representative.
Copy the client secret issued with your client id.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Use the sandbox credential pair until Karhoo approves production access.
